summary: Adagene Inc. filed a Form 6-K providing a preliminary, unaudited cash balance of US$127.9 million as of June 30, 2026. No transaction, offer, tender, or special-situation corporate action is announced. The filing is a routine periodic financial update by a foreign private issuer, disclosing a cash position and cautioning that it is unaudited. No board recommendation, adviser, or structural mechanics are referenced. This is not a special situation; it is an ordinary financial disclosure with no event to analyze.
